findings.explanation: A gust of wind is written a gust a wind.

findings.highlight: In contrast to Saber's straight sword, Assassin's blade is curved.
findings.evidenceJa: 直線的なセイバーの剣筋に対し、アサシンの剣筋は曲線を描く。
findings.governingReading: Saber's strokes follow straight paths, whereas Assassin's follow curves; his technique somehow compensates for the longer route.
findings.explanation: The opening comparison changes straight and curved attack paths into straight and curved blades. Later sentences restore the movement contrast, but its introduction gives the wrong explanation.

findings.governingReading: Assassin calls his swordsmanship unorthodox, then links his unusual skills to being an exponent of that style.
findings.explanation: Calling his sword “wicked” loses the explicit description of his technique as unorthodox. It can still refer figuratively to his swordsmanship, so it does not establish an evil artifact or a morally evil swordsman.

findings.highlight: as long the wielder is able to swing the sword
findings.evidenceJa: いかなる体勢からでも刀を振るえないようでは
findings.governingReading: いかなる体勢からでも states the ability prerequisite clearly.
findings.explanation: The conditional as long as lacks its second as.

findings.highlight: having a satisfying exchange with our blades.
findings.evidenceJa: 満足に打ち合ってもいない
findings.governingReading: 満足に打ち合ってもいない concerns insufficient sustained contact for measuring the weapon, not pleasure in the duel.
findings.explanation: Not yet exchanging blows adequately becomes not having a satisfying exchange.

findings.highlight: such tricks are the only things I get to practice.
findings.evidenceJa: このような技ばかり上手くなる
findings.governingReading: このような技ばかり上手くなる describes skewed acquired expertise in his comic modesty.
findings.explanation: Becoming good only at such tricks becomes only getting to practice them.

findings.highlight: I am unable to put my full might into every strike with this katana.
findings.evidenceJa: その剣と組み合い、力を競い合う事はできん
findings.governingReading: その剣と組み合い、力を競い合う identifies head-on blade engagement as the impossible action because his katana would break.
findings.explanation: Inability to bind blades and contest strength becomes inability to put full power into every strike.

findings.governingReading: The source introduces the unprecedented stance normally.
findings.explanation: His is used as the subject of readies.

findings.highlight: He raises his long katana up high.
findings.evidenceJa: 長刀が僅かに上げられる。
findings.governingReading: 僅かに qualifies the size of the lift while he traces the previous movement.
findings.explanation: Slightly raising the katana becomes raising it high.

findings.highlight: the demonic sword's motions he demonstrated earlier to intimidate Saber.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを戦慄させた魔剣の動きをなぞるように。
findings.governingReading: セイバーを戦慄させた states the effect on Saber, not Assassin’s intended psychological aim.
findings.explanation: A blow that made Saber shudder becomes a blow performed to intimidate her.

findings.highlight: I would need to strike with the second sword at the very same instant as the first.
findings.evidenceJa: 一息の内、ほぼ同時に行わなければならなかった
findings.governingReading: Assassin initially says almost simultaneously; Saber rejects almost because two blades existed exactly together. She then explains that the longer circular path arrives later, requiring a third path to close escape.
findings.explanation: Near-simultaneous attempts, exactly coexisting blades and different arrival times are collapsed into simultaneous striking and trajectory slowdown.

findings.highlight: his magical sword and its sheer power, reaching the realm of the gods.
findings.evidenceJa: 神域に達した力量による魔剣のみ。
findings.governingReading: 神域に達した力量による魔剣 locates the extraordinary effect in the swordsman’s attained ability, continuing the no-magecraft/no-Noble-Phantasm paradox.
findings.explanation: A sword art produced by divine-level skill becomes the magical sword’s sheer power.

findings.highlight: Saber is not confident is she will be able to dodge that secret technique again.
findings.evidenceJa: 今一度あの秘剣を躱す自信など、セイバーにはない。
findings.governingReading: 自信などない is a normal lack-of-confidence construction.
findings.explanation: Saber is not confident is she will instead of whether she will.

findings.highlight: Even the thick trees on either side of the temple gates creak and groan.
findings.evidenceJa: 太く堅固な山門の木々さえも震え、軋んでいる。
findings.governingReading: 太く堅固な山門の木々 names the wood belonging to the gate structure under the wind’s force.
findings.explanation: The thick solid gate timbers become trees on either side of the gate.

findings.highlight: strong enough prevent most people from even approaching
findings.evidenceJa: 前進を許さぬ強風の中
findings.governingReading: 前進を許さぬ strongly modifies the obstructing wind normally.
